_comment: Per-language Door43 target config for the translate pipeline. Verified 2026-07-13: org/repo naming is NOT derivable from the language code (ar lives in org 'BSOJ' not 'ar_gl'). Precedence for each field: per-call options > this file > derivation ({lang}_gl org, {lang}_{resource} repo, unfoldingWord/en_{resource}@master source). Per resourceType: tnRepo/tqRepo/twRepo/taRepo name the target repos; {tn,tq,tw,ta}SourceRef optionally override the SOURCE ref for that resource (org/repo@ref). SOURCE LANGUAGE is a first-class parameter: set sourceLang (default 'en') plus a matching {rt}SourceRef to translate FROM a non-English gateway language (e.g. Russian->Georgian: sourceLang 'ru', tnSourceRef 'ru_gl/ru_tn@master'). contextRef is intentionally omitted (no translation-context repo exists yet); pass it per-call until one is created. src/lib/script-guard.js is a runtime backstop for this same class of misconfiguration: it skips any row already in the target script before a model call ever runs, so a stale sourceRef here degrades to a no-op skip instead of silently overwriting finished translation.

ar.note: BSOJ = Arabic partner; target repos are BSOJ/ar_*. Verified 2026-08-11 by sampling every tn_*.tsv Note column in BSOJ/ar_tn for Arabic script: 18 of 66 books are finished Arabic (1JN 1PE 1TH 1TI 2JN 2PE 2TH 2TI 3JN COL EPH GAL JAS JUD PHM PHP REV TIT), JON is 63% Arabic, and the other 47 are still the English placeholder. So the earlier 2026-07-13 premise recorded here -- that ar_tn is wholly an English copy of tN, so translate TN in place from BSOJ/ar_tn -- is retired: tN now sources from unfoldingWord/en_tn@master, same as TQ/TW/TA. Row IDs still align with unfoldingWord/en_tn, so merging by ID into BSOJ/ar_tn remains correct. The script guard in src/lib/script-guard.js skips rows already in Arabic, so runs on the 18 finished books will not overwrite human work.

id.note: Matches the {lang}_gl / {lang}_{resource} convention; standard whole-book / standard article layout. All resources source from unfoldingWord/en_* by default.
